jobs.name: action-E
jobs.prompt: Create a production game animation SOURCE SHEET matching the attached chunky armored athlete references. Image1 defines identity and eight angles; image2 defines action silhouettes. Every pose in THIS sheet faces RIGHT profile (screen direction E), camera always fixed elevated frontal, helmet top visible. Rotate entire anatomy and bat for this facing, including rear views, never revert to facing right. Same teal ram shoulder armor, ivory helmet stripe, tan arms and brown leather, squat athletic proportions, exquisite crisp 16-bit-plus pixel clusters. Exactly12 separate figures in an even4-column x3-row grid with generous empty margins in EVERY cell. Same scale, common grounded foot pivot per cell. Row1 left to right: neutral ready crouch; running contact left foot; running passing left foot; running contact right foot. Row2: running passing right foot; strike backswing anticipation; bat strike contact full extension in facing direction; strike follow-through. Row3: dropping into slide; low fully extended feet-first slide in facing direction; slide recovery tucked crouch; recovery rising ready. Each pose entirely in its cell including bat and legs. No labels/gridlines, no shadows/dust/fire, no backdrop or gradient. Genuine alpha=0 background, opaque character interiors, clean pixel contours. Frame spacing and character identity matter more than embellishment. Wide landscape sheet.

jobs.name: fire-frames
jobs.prompt: Generate a GAME SPRITE SHEET of exactly8 consecutive flame animation frames arranged4columns x2rows. Flame ONLY, no torch, brazier, ground, smoke cloud or background. Match the attached Cryptball purple stone fantasy arena's chunky beautiful pixel-art fire: ivory hot core, gold and orange tongues, sparse red edges, crisp pixel clusters. Each flame has identical baseline anchor and roughly same width/height; flame tongues sway and separate across frames, looping naturally eighth to first. Generous transparent padding between equal cells, no overlapping frames. Each frame occupies own cell. Genuine alpha=0 outside flame, mostly opaque fire pixels; no large soft glow, labels or gridlines. This will overlay existing stone braziers and wall torches, so don't include any hardware. Preserve reference style.

Exactlysame4columns x3rows12pose sequence and proportions as first image. Rotate each entire character45degrees toward screen upper LEFT from its back view. We see predominantly BACK armor and BACK of helmet, ONE rear side cheekguard at most, NOT the open face slit or chest. EVERY pose must show the rear torso including slides and strikes. Running moves away diagonally upper LEFT; sliding feet extend away diagonally upper LEFT with back facing us; bat strike thrust aimed away diagonally upper LEFT. Row2 runD/backswing/contact/followthrough. Row3 slideEntry/slideActive/recoveryLow/recoveryUp. Transparent background, opaque interiors, no effects/shadows/labels/grid.
